title: MISP contains an authorization bypass in its event search and filter functionality. (CVE-2026-132636)
description: MISP has an authorization bypass vulnerability in its event search and filter functionality that allows users with event view access to infer the existence and enumerate values of restricted attributes and objects. This occurs because search queries do not enforce per-attribute distribution, sharing-group, or soft-deleted visibility rules. The flaw enables enumeration of hidden attribute values via prefix matching and leaks tags attached exclusively to hidden attributes through various filter paths.
